reviews.review_description:
🫟Super Chameleon is all kinds of fun with friends.  

If you're a chameleon 🦎, trying to hide and paint yourself into the scenery is a definite skill.  Picking the best place to hide can be nerve racking in the best possible way.  
If you're the seeker, trying to find your friends can be a challenge or it might just be too easy, if they pick the wrong spot to try and hide.

Give this a try with your friends and I believe you'll have a blast.  

⭐Tip for the Chameleons- You can always just run for it, if you have to!

⚠️ Warning ☢️ - May cause unstoppable laughing 🤭
I've loved the game ever since I started it for the first time!, its a blast every time I play it.

The game is polished and feels great to play
Its never ending fun!

reviews.review_title: Great fun for all age groups.
reviews.review_description:
Really great fun entertainment for all age groups. Even better when you jump into a lobby with friends.
It's important that this game allows all players to play without having to buy the Founders pack, however by availing of the pack, it gives you freedom to host your own matches, the ability to kick or mute players who may cause trouble, choose all maps yourself. Players who haven't paid for the pack can also join in.

I have been involved with this game since the start and a lot of effort has been put in by the solo developer to ensure the best playable experience. With the recent update, we have all read everybody's reviews, both here and in the discord and have tweaked a lot of systems within the game to make it even more enjoyable experience. 

Sadly, with the closure of some of the other Quest, chameleon type games that had shut down, we are delighted that we can fill a space for players who enjoy playing these kind of games. 

Join the discord, so that you can keep up with events and benefits offered within a friendly and growing community server.

After playing a number of chameleon games on standalone headset, I have to say this was the most polished and most enjoyable. I have read other reviews here with players complaining about the movement system. ￼Honestly, the gorilla movement is so smoothly done, when you are a chameleon, you move faster and when you are a hunter you move slower which gives a good balance to the overall matches. In addition to that when you go into spectator and edit mode you use grab movement which not many other games I’ve played have this feature. It means you can spectate while you’re hiding. It is also great that you can quickly paint your character select different types of materials and have a full colour pallet to use as well as using the eyedropper to make blending into areas much easier. ￼ the proximity chat is so precise￼ you can playfully troll the hunter and have fun banter with the other players in the game. ￼￼ I had a really fun time playing this game, especially with friends it’s full of laughs. ￼

The game is still under development and lacks a lot of content. The maps feel too small, the hunter moves too slowly, and the overall game feels unpolished. I think the concept is good and has a lot of potential, but the execution needs improvement. Another issue is that it feels like you have to pay to access around 50% of the game's content, which takes away from the overall experience. With larger maps, better movement, more polish, and more accessible content, I think this game could be much better.
